# `/access-request-approvals` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /access-request-approvals/v1/pending

`listPendingApprovalsV1` — Pending access request approvals list

This endpoint returns a list of pending approvals. See "owner-id" query parameter below for authorization info. For access requests for machines, each approval will include `identityType` as `MACHINE` and `requestedFor` with `type: MACHINE_IDENTITY` and the machine id. Approvals without a stored identity type are returned as `HUMAN` / `IDENTITY`. When a requested object has an associated form, each approval may include a `form` object with the form definition ID, instance ID, and answers…

- Scopes: idn:access-request-approvals:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `owner-id` (query) — If present, the value returns only pending approvals for the specified identity. * ORG_ADMIN users can call this with any identity ID value. * ORG_ADMIN users can also fetch all the approvals in the…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; requestedFor.id: eq, in; modified: gt, lt, ge, le, eq, in; accessRequestId: eq, in; created: gt, lt, ge, le, eq, in — e.g. `id eq "2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: created, modified — e.g. `modified`
- Returns 200: array of pendingapproval

### POST /access-request-approvals/v1/{approvalId}/approve

`approveAccessRequestV1` — Approve access request approval

Use this endpoint to approve an access request approval. Only the owner of the approval and ORG_ADMIN users are allowed to perform this action.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-approvals:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, APPROVAL_OWNER
- Parameters:
  - `approvalId` (path, required) — Approval ID.
- Body (application/json): commentdto
- Returns 202: object

### POST /access-request-approvals/v1/{approvalId}/reject

`rejectAccessRequestV1` — Reject access request approval

Use this API to reject an access request approval. Only the owner of the approval and admin users are allowed to perform this action.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-approvals:manage
- Parameters:
  - `approvalId` (path, required) — Approval ID.
- Body (application/json): commentdto
- Returns 202: object

### POST /access-request-approvals/v1/{approvalId}/forward

`forwardAccessRequestV1` — Forward access request approval

Use this API to forward an access request approval to a new owner. Only the owner of the approval and ORG_ADMIN users are allowed to perform this action. Only the owner of the approval and ORG_ADMIN users are allowed to perform this action.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-approvals:manage
- Parameters:
  - `approvalId` (path, required) — Approval ID.
- Body (application/json): forwardapprovaldto
- Returns 202: object

### GET /access-request-approvals/v1/approval-summary

`getAccessRequestApprovalSummaryV1` — Get access requests approvals number

Use this API to return the number of pending, approved and rejected access requests approvals. See the "owner-id" query parameter for authorization information. info.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-approvals:read
- Parameters:
  - `owner-id` (query) — The ID of the owner or approver identity of the approvals. If present, the value returns approval summary for the specified identity. * ORG_ADMIN users can call this with any identity ID value. *…
  - `from-date` (query) — This is the date and time the results will be shown from. It must be in a valid ISO-8601 format.
- Returns 200: approvalsummary

### GET /access-request-approvals/v1/{accessRequestId}/approvers

`listAccessRequestApproversV1` — Access request approvers

This API endpoint returns the list of approvers for the given access request id.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-administration:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `accessRequestId` (path, required) — Access Request ID.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return.
  - `offset` (query) — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. Defaults to 0 if not specified.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If this is true, the *X-Total-Count* response header populates with the number of results that would be returned if limit and offset were ignored.
- Returns 200: array of accessrequestapproverslistresponse

### POST /access-request-approvals/v1/bulk-approve

`approveBulkAccessRequestV1` — Bulk approve access request

This API endpoint allows approving pending access requests in bulk. Maximum of 50 approval ids can be provided in the request for one single invocation. ORG_ADMIN or users with rights "idn:access-request-administration:write" can approve the access requests in bulk.

- Scopes: idn:access-request:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): bulkapproveaccessrequest
- Returns 202: object
